title: Parsley Health media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for media until a real one is passed in: a soft beige-to-seafoam wash for photos, or a faint tint of the text colour for cut-outs, feeds and anything on a coloured band. It fills the box it is given.
notes: size, radius and shape come from the parent or className
name: parsleyhealth-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: photo: soft beige-to-seafoam wash · tint: a faint tint of the text colour (for coloured bands)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Portrait")
